title: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs and let them sit for a few seconds.
Gently stir with a spatula, folding the eggs until just set.
Take them off the heat while still slightly soft and serve.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place the cheese between the slices, buttered sides facing out.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the sandwich until golden, about 3 minutes per side, pressing gently.
Slice in half and serve warm.

title: Basic Pancakes
instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Stir the wet ingredients into the dry until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly greased pan over medium heat.
Pour a quarter cup of batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on top.
Flip and cook another minute until golden, then serve.

title: Spaghetti with Tomato Sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a pan and cook the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes and a pinch of salt, and simmer for ten minutes.
Stir in torn basil at the end.
Drain the pasta and toss it with the sauce, then serve.

title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook in butter until done, then slice.
Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente and drain.
In the same pan, warm the cream and melt in the parmesan to make a sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and top with the sliced chicken.
Serve right away while hot.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Scoop the avocados into a bowl and mash to your preferred texture.
Finely chop the onion and cilantro and stir them in.
Squeeze in the lime juice and add salt to taste.
Mix well and serve with chips or on toast.

title: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan or wok over high heat.
Scramble the eggs in the pan, then push them to one side.
Add the vegetables and cook for a couple of minutes.
Add the cold cooked rice and the soy sauce, stirring to combine and heat through.
Top with sliced green onions and serve.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Melt the butter in a pot and cook the chopped onion until soft.
Add the crushed tomatoes and broth and simmer for fifteen minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth.
Stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper.
Warm through and serve.
